transfer_requirement.rule: Each student must independently apply a learned principle to an unfamiliar data-engineering scenario before cohort-thesis eligibility.

final_state_rule: Program completion requires real student-produced artifacts for every module, independent evaluation, per-student transfer evidence, a cohort thesis, professor disciplinary readiness recommendation, and IMHOTEP final thesis validation. Matriculation or assignment issuance is not evidence of learning.
